data_fields.name: pink_refresh_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 90 (refresh only at or below this many seconds left)

data_fields.name: wanted_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 86400 (24 h after last PK stamp, 24*3600*1000 ms)

data_fields.name: pk_lawful_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 30000 (PK count and stamp only if killer lawful is under this)

data_fields.name: pk_lawful_drop_min
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 (killer lawful at least this far below current)

best_idea: One alignment number decides the death item-loss chance, a PK kill pushes the killer's number at least 1000 lower, and a hostile act marks the attacker pink for a window that a repeat act only refreshes near its end.
decision_why: One alignment number is a single ledger that fits our one-ledger rule, and the pink window and PK count fit the open PvP flag; drop the karma level ladder (display only) and the chaotic double-rate until Lead wants a second alignment track, and make the pink window a server end-stamp.
acceptance: A player who kills a lawful, non-pink player gets a PK count and a 24-hour Wanted mark and a visible guard target; a server test asserts killer lawful falls by at least 1000 per PK kill and stops at -32768, pink ends at a server time stamp 180 s after the last hostile act (a repeat act within the last 90 s resets it to 180 s), and a victim at lawful 0 has a 12.8 percent per-death roll for item loss.
